title: FC 5403: General Requirements
officialText:
5403.1 Quantities not exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area.

The storage, handling and use of corrosive materials in amounts not exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area indicated in FC 5003.1 shall be in accordance with FC 5001, 5003 and 5401.

5403.2 Quantities exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area.

The storage, handling and use of corrosive materials in amounts exceeding the maximum allowable quantity per control area indicated in FC 5003.1 shall be in accordance with this chapter and FC Chapter 50.
